notes: Dose-response paper (ifdoseresponse=1). GT uses normalized dose fractions (0.4, 0.67, 1.0) corresponding to actual doses 1.8, 3.0, 4.5 L/ha (ratios relative to max dose 4.5 L/ha: 1.8/4.5=0.40, 3.0/4.5=0.667, 4.5/4.5=1.0). GT ctrl_mean values (0.0994, 0.082, 0.0809) differ from JSON values (994, 820, 809 kg/ha) by exactly 10,000x (unit conversion); effect percentages are identical confirming correct matching. Three years of data: 2015 (GT pairs 426-428, json_idx 0-2), 2016 (GT pairs 429-431, json_idx 3-5), 2017 (GT pairs 432-434, json_idx 6-8). All 9 GT rows matched perfectly to 9 per-year per-dose seed yield JSON observations. JSON obs 18 is a 3-year average for dose 1.8 L/ha only (not a per-dose duplicate of the per-year data). JSON obs 9-17 are germination capacity (quality metric, not yield), and obs 19-28 are morphological/SPAD non-yield traits, none of which appear in the Li 2022 yield meta-analysis.
